name: Last Call at the High-Score Cabinet
description: An arcade cabinet has vanished from the neon district, taking its legendary high score with it. Search the lab network and recover the cabinet's archived score record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the Record
tasks.description: The cabinet's archived high score is somewhere on the lab network. Find the cabinet and recover its record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Pay attention to the first response you receive from each open port; the port number alone may not tell the whole story.
One listener behaves like a mailbox service. Compare its greeting with familiar application protocols.
Use the credentials announced in that service's greeting, then inspect the stored message containing the score record.
